title: Hybrid direct prompt attention (direct only for prompt rows whose own context spans <= 12 pages): verification and 5-pair qualification (Qwen3-4B, A100 GPU7)
registered: 2026-10-23 KST, before the GPU test and any serving arm of this experiment
user_decision: 2026-10-23: build a hybrid that uses the direct kernel only for prompt rows with short context, chosen by the row's own context length; pre-register and verify.
mode: RILEY_NATIVE_D128_PROMPT_DIRECT=1 with RILEY_NATIVE_D128_PROMPT_DIRECT_MAX_PAGES=12. A prompt row at position p is direct iff p/16 + 1 <= 12 (p < 192); longer prompt rows keep the four-page segment states folded by the merge; decode rows unchanged. The choice depends only on the row itself.
threshold_choice: 12 pages chosen before this experiment from the workload shapes: all fixed prompts (115-130 tokens, <= 9 pages) and the natural 16/128-token prompts are entirely direct, while rows of the 398-token prompt beyond position 191 keep the segment path, whose parallel segments the full-direct mode lost (section 13: natural C32 -0.51%).

binaries.candidate: riley-phase1-v10 (sha recorded at build), same native-extra.json, environment RILEY_NATIVE_D128_PROMPT_DIRECT=1 and RILEY_NATIVE_D128_PROMPT_DIRECT_MAX_PAGES=12; burst, fused and segment-decode modes off

gates.G1_gpu_unit_test: prompt_direct_attention_gpu passes for all 8 geometries at 20 and 120 pages, including the hybrid checks at a 4-page bound: every short prompt row equals the full-direct bytes, every long prompt row equals the segment-path bytes, decode rows unchanged, padding zero, and hybrid bytes independent of order, tile alignment, generated-row list and chunking
gates.G2_serving_invariance: candidate arms only: measured 192/192 equal to the candidate's own canonical outputs in every arm; no mismatch among its correctness outputs across all cells (per-mode canonical sets)
gates.G3_hf_agreement: candidate HF token matches on the 15-prompt correctness set >= 11 of 15 per pass at every concurrency
gates.G4_primary_performance: fixed C32: median-of-5 paired throughput change >= +1.5%. Changed from the previous registration (natural C32 >= +2%) because the hybrid's purpose is to keep the short-prompt gain while removing the long-prompt loss; the natural cells are covered by G5.
gates.G5_noninferiority: every cell, natural C8/C32 included: median-of-5 paired throughput change >= -1.3%, TPOT p50 change <= +1.5%, TPOT p99 change <= +10%

cells: fixed C1/C8/C16/C32 and natural C8/C32, 5 fresh pairs each, 64 warm + 192 measured, runner order alternation
reporting: All pairs and metrics including TTFT; measured-workload HF matches; nothing excluded or repeated; an aborted arm is preserved and continued under a new label
decision: All gates pass -> adopt as the recommended Qwen3-4B native prompt attention and add explicit server flags; any gate fails -> keep the segment-state prompt path and record why
